actual_prime_decompositions.routes: Actual primes use Green-Tao 2010 at low complexity, Halupczok 2013 and Montgomery-Vaughan 1973 for windows, and Frei-Tinkova 2025 for coupled principal prime values. These routes do not depend on the 2026 semigroup G/ZF inputs.
actual_prime_decompositions.full_star: For fixed r, even L>=4 and N_j in [T,CT] with N_j=3 mod L, actual-prime stars have count asymptotic to L^r/phi(L)^(2r+1) times V_r, the product of all good-prime beta factors, and log^(-(2r+1)) T. Complexity-one partitions are verified for every star form. Distinctness does not change the main term.
actual_prime_decompositions.windows: For 2/3<theta<1 and H=T^theta, the centered star count has order H^(r+1)/log^(2r+1) T. Brun-Titchmarsh gives H/log T candidates instead of the old H/log^2 T bound. A union of fixed r binary exceptional sets and independent private choices gives the lower bound; explicit Selberg diagonalization, Mertens-Markov estimates and the CRT remainder give the upper bound. Requiring all primes to be distinct preserves the order.
actual_prime_decompositions.D23: The Hilbert class field of Q(sqrt(-23)) has group S3 and maximal abelian subfield K. Principal-form prime values are the identity Frobenius class, of density 1/6. Compatible progressions modulo 23 have density 1/66. Every sufficiently large odd N has three distinct principal-form prime values, with coefficient 23 B_23/66^3, B_23=66,55,60, and the ordinary good-prime product. The coupled five-prime version holds for all sufficiently large comparable odd N,M.
actual_prime_decompositions.basis: For P_L consisting of primes 1 mod L, the basis order with zero padding is L+1 or L+2. It is L+1 if and only if all sufficiently large N=2 mod L are actual binary prime sums. Thus the P_12 order is 13 or 14, whereas order 13 for the C_12 core is already proved.
actual_prime_decompositions.barrier: The current graph reconstruction puts primes and endpoints with a fixed bound on Omega entirely in the rare-bank remainder, and uses multiplication invariance that prime indicators lack. No all-target binary-prime or prime-plus-semigroup corollary is claimed.
actual_prime_decompositions.scope: Parameters are fixed. Window bounds give the order only. Full-star counts use ordinary prime local factors at all good primes. A regular local obstruction can still allow thin solutions with a variable equal to the same small prime in general patterns.
